title: IMADI Tech overview
content: IMADI Tech, founded by Maria Aziz, builds AI agents, intelligent software, and automation systems for real-world businesses. Its focus is practical technology that reduces manual work, connects disconnected workflows, and helps businesses operate more efficiently.

title: Automation opportunities
content: IMADI Tech works on sales and CRM automation, operations workflow automation, customer-support AI agents and WhatsApp automation, document processing with OCR and extraction, e-commerce product synchronization and order workflows, and automated reporting and data integration.

title: IMADI Tech delivery process
content: IMADI Tech follows a four-stage approach: Understand, Identify, Build, Improve. It starts from the real business problem rather than forcing a generic technology.

title: Maria Aziz expertise
content: Maria Aziz describes her work as AI-powered products, intelligent automation, conversational systems, machine learning and NLP, and scalable SaaS. Her process includes understanding the problem, researching, solution design, building, testing and measuring impact.

title: UK logistics ERP
content: A custom full-stack business management system built for a UK logistics and fulfillment company, covering sales, invoices, VAT, purchasing, inventory, logistics, double-entry accounting, banking, reporting, role-based permissions and backups.

title: ReNaz WhatsApp automation
content: ReNaz is a WhatsApp-based waste and scrap collection platform in Pakistan. Customers request pickups through WhatsApp with waste type, quantity, location and time slot; the platform matches requests to verified collectors and provides an admin dashboard.
